== Summary ==
Slip “•A Jedi’s Focus” cut unchanged from page 5 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 1707, 581, 1992)). Version [[A Jedi's Focus (V)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
